entries.description: Code review of Document layer (BaseColor, Document, PageSize, Rectangle) via Gemini Pro with Sonnet cross-verification. Findings: Document.Close() resource leak when writer set but Open() never called; Rectangle lacks value equality; BaseColor naming convention (Red_, Green_, Blue_); EnsureOpen dead code path.

Fixed Document.Close() state consistency: _closed now always set to true. Reordered EnsureOpen() checks so _closed is checked before !_open (dead code fix). Declined Rectangle→record (too invasive for V&V), BaseColor naming (deliberate), thread safety (not applicable).

Test gap analysis and new tests added. RectangleTests: +4 (FourArgConstructor, CopyConstructor independence, ToString, ZeroDimensions). PageSizeTests: +5 (A3, A5, Tabloid, Executive, AllOriginAtZero). DocumentIntegrationTests: +4 (PageNumber tracking, Close-without-Open, Close idempotent, NewPage-after-Close). BaseColorTests: +5 (GetHashCode consistency, null equality, both-null equality, ToString, LightGray/DarkGray).
dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: Passed 222, Failed 0.
Cross-provider verification with gemini-pro (1 round). Session review saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.
